tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# Define the necessary Role for the config-reader service account
ROLE_YAML="---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: default
  name: config-reader-role
rules:
- apiGroups: ['']
  resources: ['configmaps']
  verbs: ['get', 'list']
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: config-reader-binding
  namespace: default
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: config-reader
  namespace: default
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: config-reader-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io"

# Apply the Role and RoleBinding to grant read access to ConfigMaps in the default namespace
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
$ROLE_YAML
EOF

echo "RBAC resources applied."

# To ensure the change takes effect and the unhealthy pods restart, I will roll out the deployment.
# The deployment name is 'app' in the 'default' namespace.
echo "Rolling out the deployment 'app' to refresh permissions..."
kubectl rollout restart deployment app -n default

echo "Restart initiated. Checking status of the deployment..."
kubectl rollout status deployment app -n default"}

{"command":"# Define the necessary Role for the config-reader service account
ROLE_YAML="---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: default
  name: config-reader-role
rules:
- apiGroups: ['']
  resources: ['configmaps']
  verbs: ['get', 'list']
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: config-reader-binding
  namespace: default
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: config-reader
  namespace: default
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: config-reader-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io"

# Apply the Role and RoleBinding to grant read access to ConfigMaps in the default namespace
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
$ROLE_YAML
EOF

echo "RBAC resources applied."

# To ensure the change takes effect and the unhealthy pods restart, I will roll out the deployment.
# The deployment name is 'app' in the 'default' namespace.
echo "Rolling out the deployment 'app' to refresh permissions..."
kubectl rollout restart deployment app -n default

echo "Restart initiated. Checking status of the deployment..."
kubectl rollout status deployment app -n default"}
